characters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One full-body enemy character concept on plain warm gray paper, square canvas, no words, no panels. Image 1 is ONLY anatomy/proportion reference: giant pointed broad cap with layered underside, tiny rounded body, two small tapered feet and two short flipper-like arms. Preserve these volumes and short-limb articulation. Image 2 is painted dark-fairytale visual style reference only, not a background to reproduce. Crisp ink contours, hand-painted gouache shading, restrained weathered textures, readable at mobile game size. Cute silhouette with unsettling supernatural detail, mild horror. Character is facing SCREEN LEFT in a clear three-quarter combat stance, eyes and mouth clustered toward LEFT edge of body, visible right side plane; never front-facing. Entire cap and both feet visible, no separate props, no additional limbs, no long dangling appendages. Cap about 60% total height and wider than body. A forest leaf reliquary imp. Giant pointed cap made of overlapping dead olive leaves, woody veins and near-black curled rim, very few tiny rusty seed husks embedded flush in the cap. Body pale warm rootwood, plump like a sleepy seedling. Two irregular hollow eye sockets; the tiny mouth is a vertical seed-shaped dark opening, no teeth. Main uncanny motif: a single large closed eyelid naturally formed by leaf veins across the cap, subtle but legible; dark amber sap weeps from one corner. Cute drooping expression and stubby feet. Muted olive, parchment beige, warm amber accents. No mushrooms growing on it, no clothing, no exposed bones, no blood.
